body.x: Huria(representative Eui-bong Park, www.huria.co.kr) is showing Headphone/ Headset/ Earset of bone conduction at CES 2012(Consumer Electronics Show 2012) held in Las Vegas, US from Jan 10 to 13 (local time).
(Picture1: Wireless Bone Conduction Headset 'EARBONE(HUB-401) of Huria)

Bone conduction technology means technology that delivers sound through vibration of bone not through tympanic membrane. People who has conduction deafness can perceive sound with Bone Conduction Headphone, and people who has healthy ear can enjoy the music while hearing surrounding sound. Bone Conduction Headphone deliver sound to nerve through Bone not through eardrum. Also, it prevents the damage of eardrum and reduces the stress of the ear

Huria introduced five kinds of Bone Conduction products, Waterproof Bone Conduction headphone 'Beat Bone (HUH-701)'and normal Bone Conduction headphone 'Vibrato(HUH-01),'Amplifier type Bone Conduction headphone 'Woori Bone(HUH 101)', Wireless Bone Conduction Headset 'Ear Bone(HUB-401)', Bone Conduction Earset 'Saybone(SBone-03)'.

Waterproof Bone Conduction headphone 'Beat Bone( HUH-701)' obtained IPX7 waterproof certification in Japan , so it's suitable for water activities, and in case of normal Bone Conduction headphone 'Vibrato(HUH-01),', it has a weak waterproof function but it strengthened sound output.
Amplifier type Bone Conduction headphone 'Woori Bone( HUH 101)' has equal level of sound output with normal earphone by equipping amplifier function.

Wireless Bone Conduction Headset 'EARBONE(HUB-401), developed at first by Huria, has embedded Mike and it has Bluetooth function to be compared with all kinds of electronic equipment, also it improved weakness of low output, with amplifier function.

Bone Conduction Earset 'Saybone (SBone-03)' combined Bone conduction mike and normal earphone, this product deliver only user's voice who insert Bone conduction mike inside ear. So, it can be used usefully and variously when user in noisy environment and industrial settings, and user drives a car and enjoys leisure activities.
